speech.heard: India sees 93% of births protected against tetanus, in Somalia it's 50%. It counts births by women of childbearing age who are immunized against tetanus. Somalia sits at the world's lowest rate at 50%. That gives India 1.9 times the protection Somalia has. Across other nations, Mexico has 98% while Afghanistan drops to 62%. How well are newborns protected against tetanus where you live?
